rules.content:
title: E-Skimmer Script Injection on Payment Pages
status: experimental
description: Detects unauthorized JavaScript injection on e-commerce payment pages by identifying Content Security Policy violations, unexpected external script loads from newly registered domains, and unauthorize
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: web_security
detection:
    selection_csp:
        event_type: "csp_violation"
        page_uri|contains:
            - "/checkout"
            - "/payment"
            - "/billing"
            - "/cart/complete"
        blocked_uri|re: "https?://[^/]+\\.[a-z]{2,}"
    selection_script_load:
        event_type: "script_load"
        page_uri|contains:
            - "/checkout"
            - "/payment"
            - "/billing"
        script_domain_age_days|lte: 90
    filter_authorized_scripts:
        script_domain|contains:
            - "google-analytics.com"
            - "googletagmanager.com"
            - "googleapis.com"
            - "gstatic.com"
    selection_gtm_modification:
        event_type: "gtm_container_update"
        change_type|contains:
            - "tag_created"
            - "tag_modified"
            - "custom_html_added"
    condition: selection_csp or (selection_script_load and not filter_authorized_scripts) or selection_gtm_modification
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0075: E-Skimmer Script Injection on Payment Pages (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Blockchain C2 and WebSocket Exfiltration from Payment Pages
status: experimental
description: Detects payment page scripts making calls to blockchain RPC endpoints or establishing WebSocket connections to unknown servers, indicating potential e-skimmer data exfiltration via blockchain-based co
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: network_traffic
detection:
    selection_blockchain_rpc:
        src_page_uri|contains:
            - "/checkout"
            - "/payment"
            - "/billing"
            - "/cart/complete"
        dst_domain|contains:
            - "infura.io"
            - "alchemy.com"
            - "etherscan.io"
            - "bscscan.com"
            - "cloudflare-eth.com"
            - "ankr.com"
        request_method: "POST"
        request_body|contains:
            - "eth_call"
            - "eth_getStorageAt"
            - "eth_getLogs"
    selection_websocket_unknown:
        src_page_uri|contains:
            - "/checkout"
            - "/payment"
            - "/billing"
        connection_type: "websocket"
    filter_known_payment_processors:
        dst_domain|contains:
            - "stripe.com"
            - "paypal.com"
            - "braintreegateway.com"
            - "adyen.com"
            - "authorize.net"
            - "cybersource.com"
            - "worldpay.com"
            - "square.com"
            - "shopify.com"
    condition: selection_blockchain_rpc or (selection_websocket_unknown and not filter_known_payment_processors)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0076: Blockchain C2 and WebSocket Exfiltration from Payment Pages (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Unauthorized Checkout Page DOM Modification
status: experimental
description: Detects modifications to checkout page DOM elements — including payment form fields, submit buttons, and iframe injections — that occur outside authorized deployment windows or without corresponding c
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: client_side_monitoring
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "dom_mutation"
            - "element_injected"
            - "form_modified"
            - "iframe_created"
        page_uri|contains:
            - "/checkout"
            - "/payment"
            - "/billing"
        target_element|contains:
            - "payment-form"
            - "card-number"
            - "cc-number"
            - "card-expiry"
            - "card-cvc"
            - "billing-address"
            - "submit-payment"
    filter_authorized_deployment:
        deployment_id|exists: true
        deployment_window: true
    filter_framework_mutations:
        mutation_source|contains:
            - "react"
            - "angular"
            - "vue"
            - "next"
            - "nuxt"
    condition: selection and not filter_authorized_deployment and not filter_framework_mutations
level: high
rules.title: DL-0077: Unauthorized Checkout Page DOM Modification (Sigma)
